definitions.onTime: On time = arrived at the receiving gate by the agreed promise (arrivedAt ≤ promisedBy). Renegotiated shipments count against their agreed new window and are also counted separately.
definitions.fairOnTime: Fair on-time: Counts against the transporter only if the shipment would have been on time without the transporter's minutes. Computed from the final attributed minutes.
definitions.warningLead: Warning lead = promised time − the first time the shipment was At risk, for shipments that reached At risk (median).
definitions.proactiveNotice: Proactive notice = late or at-risk shipments whose customer was notified before the promised time ÷ all late or at-risk shipments.
definitions.recovered: Recovered = shipments that reached At risk, had a recovery action chosen and arrived on time ÷ shipments that reached At risk.
